cues: A tendon is packed with parallel bundles of white collagen.
Pull it, and it barely stretches.
A ligament has branching yellow elastic fibres.
Pull it, and it stretches, then springs back.
text: Two dense tissues, always compared. A tendon is packed with parallel bundles of white collagen. Pull it, and it barely stretches. A ligament has branching yellow elastic fibres. Pull it, and it stretches, then springs back.
